premises.text: Produce spoils across long supply chains while synthetic pesticides are being banned and natural wax alternatives are hard to scale
premises.evidence_span: currently used pesticides are synthetic compounds, which are harmful to human beings and the environment, so they are being banned

premises.text: Coating matches common synthetic fungicide efficacy on citrus, extends shelf life and quality for avocados/berries, and supports zero-residue marketing premium

premises.text: Stable cell-free formulation integrates with existing packing machinery without special storage logistics required by living-microbe competitors
